title: Warranty Coverage Discount Program Carry-Over to Trip Charges
content:
**Clause.** When the contract a Warranty Coverage registration covers was signed under a discount program, a program discount applies in pricing the trip charge of a technician visit billed under that registration:

- signed under the **military** discount program: the program discount is that contract series' military discount rate;
- under the **first-responder** program: the series' first-responder discount rate;
- under the **senior** program: the series' senior discount rate;
- a contract signed with no discount program takes no program discount.

## Where the program and the rates are read

| Registration covers | Program and series rates read from |
|---|---|
| a window contract | the Window Replacement Contracts record of that contract and its series |
| a door contract | the Entry & Patio Door Contracts record of that contract and its series |

The rate is the series' rate for the program the contract was signed under.

## Cases (hypothetical rates)

| Program on the contract | Series rate for that program | Program discount |
|---|---|---|
| military | 12 percent | 12 percent |
| first-responder | 9 percent | 9 percent |
| senior | 6 percent | 6 percent |
| none | — | none |
